name: Skill Eval: github-skills (issue #171)
description: Four-arm eval for github-skills. Measures skill-vs-terse delta for GitHub workflow tasks. Run with: sin-code eval run --dataset evals/skill-github.json --arm baseline,terse,lazy_skill,skill-github-actions

test_cases.prompt: Create a GitHub Actions CI workflow that runs go test on push to main. Use n8n delegation (M1).
test_cases.description: skill-github-actions should produce an n8n-delegated workflow, not a runner-based one.

test_cases.prompt: Create a README.md structure for a CLI tool repo called 'mycli'. Include badges, quick start, and llms.txt.
test_cases.description: skill-github-readme should produce enterprise visual standard output with template variables.
